title: Settings
subtitle: Make DocuRebuild yours. Everything is stored locally.

appearance.themeDescription: Choose light, dark, or follow your system setting.
appearance.accentDescription: Used for primary actions, selections, and highlights.
appearance.radiusDescription: Adjust how rounded panels and controls feel.
appearance.blurDescription: Transparency and blur on panels and dialogs.
appearance.densityDescription: Controls the height of toolbars and form fields.
appearance.fontSizeDescription: Only the application interface changes. Documents keep their own typography.
appearance.motionDescription: Reduce motion for comfort or accessibility.

language.title: Application language
language.description: Only the interface language changes. Your documents and OCR content are never translated.
language.burmeseNote: Burmese uses Unicode. Zawgyi text is preserved exactly as imported and is never converted automatically.

editor.description: Used for the document editor and future exports. Interface typography stays independent.
editor.preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. မြန်မာစာ စမ်းသပ်ချက်။

ocr.title: Local OCR engine
ocr.description: Tesseract extracts text on this device. Page images are never uploaded to an OCR service.
ocr.missingBurmese: Burmese (mya) language data is not installed. Install it before running Burmese OCR.
ocr.setupDescription: Install Tesseract and add the eng and mya traineddata files to its tessdata folder. If Tesseract is not on PATH, set DOCUREBUILD_TESSERACT_CMD to the executable.
ocr.privacy: OCR jobs run in a bounded local worker. Nothing is sent to a remote service, and no paid API is used.

unavailableReasons.not_found: Tesseract could not be found on this device.
unavailableReasons.not_executable: The configured Tesseract command cannot be run.
unavailableReasons.no_languages: Tesseract is installed, but no language data is available.
unavailableReasons.error: The OCR engine could not be checked.

ai.title: Local AI assistance
ai.description: Connect a local inference server to propose OCR text corrections. AI output is always a proposal until you review it.
ai.providerDescription: Both options expect a server running on this device or your own network.
ai.baseUrlDescription: Leave empty to use the provider default. The URL is only contacted when you test the connection or request a cleanup.
ai.modelDescription: Used for OCR text cleanup. Type a model name or test the connection to discover installed models.
ai.noModels: The server responded but reported no models. Pull or load a model first.
ai.testHint: A connection test only lists models. It does not download, load, or generate anything.

errorReasons.ai_unreachable: Nothing is listening at this URL. Start the local server and check the port.
errorReasons.ai_timeout: The server did not answer in time. It may still be loading the model.
errorReasons.ai_http_error: The server answered with an error. Check the URL and the server log.
errorReasons.ai_invalid_response: The response did not look like an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible API.

ai.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Save the profile before using it.
ai.enabledHint: AI cleanup is available in the OCR review dialog.
ai.notConfigured: Choose a model to enable AI cleanup.
ai.privacy: Only the selected text block is sent, to the server URL you configure. No cloud service is contacted and no paid API is used. Every response stays a proposal until you accept it.

storage.title: Local storage
storage.pathDescription: The application database, project folders, and immutable source files live here. Nothing is uploaded to a cloud service.
storage.offline: The storage location is unavailable while the local backend is offline.
storage.privacyNote: GitHub backs up source code and documentation only — never your documents or imported pages.

about.title: About DocuRebuild
about.principles: Built around local-first, free-first, accuracy-first principles.
